title: Chevrolet Silverado HD Engines by Year
description: Every factory engine in the Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD and 3500HD by year, 1999–2026: Vortec 6.0 and 8.1 V8s, every Duramax diesel from LB7 to L5P, and the 6.6 gas V8.
intro: Chevrolet's heavy-duty Silverado pickups, the 2500HD and 3500HD, arrived with the 2001 GMT800 trucks; the 1999–2000 light-duty Silverado 2500 is included. The 3500 shares the 2500's engines, sometimes at lower ratings for the heaviest models.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: GMT800
intro: The 6.0 and 8.1 Vortec V8s and the Duramax diesel: the LB7, then the LLY for 2004.5–2005 and the LBZ from 2006.

generations.name: GMT900
intro: The 6.0 V8 and the LMM and then LML Duramax.

generations.name: K2XX
intro: The 6.0 V8 and the LML, then the L5P Duramax from 2017.

generations.name: T1
intro: The 6.6 gasoline V8 and the L5P Duramax, uprated for 2024.
